title: Replace hardcoded 'cloudBorn' literal and profile_model.dart's reimplemented switch with AccountTier/ProfileMode's own storageKey/fromStorageKey
rule: Fowler-duplication (self-flagged by each VO's own 'Migration note')

evidence.quote: Direct string comparisons (`profile.mode == 'child'`) should be replaced

why: account_tier.dart's own docstring names exactly this anti-pattern as the W5.11 sweep target, yet the primary caller of DeviceRegistryDatabase.updateAccountTier (the local→cloud upgrade flow) hardcodes the raw literal 'cloudBorn' at all 4 of its call sites instead of using AccountTier.cloud.storageKey — the read path (DeviceAccountX.accountTier) already goes through the typed enum, so write and read now use two unlinked representations of the same key. Separately, profile_model.dart re-implements ProfileMode's string↔enum mapping with its own switch (silently defaulting to adult) instead of calling ProfileMode.fromStorageKey (which throws on unrecognized values). Neither currently misbehaves — the literals happen to match — but a typo or a future storage-key rename in the VO would not be caught by the compiler at any of these 5 sites, and the two ProfileMode mappings already have different error-handling semantics (throw vs. silent default) for what is meant to be the same conversion.
recommendation: Replace the 4 'cloudBorn' literals with AccountTier.cloud.storageKey; have profile_model.dart's profileMode getter delegate to ProfileMode.fromStorageKey (wrapped in the same kind of fail-safe try/catch pattern already used in child_mode_guard.dart) instead of re-switching.
acceptance_criteria: upgrade_to_cloud_service.dart contains zero raw 'cloudBorn'/'localBorn' string literals; all go through AccountTier.*.storageKey.
profile_model.dart's profileMode getter calls ProfileMode.fromStorageKey (or documents why it deliberately diverges).

corrections: profile_mode.dart quote is at line 11, not 10. upgrade_to_cloud_service.dart 'cloudBorn' lines are 183/222/325/362, not 183/221/324/361 (3 of 4 off by one).
